steps: Name the minion and settle its concept.
Write a short description of what it is and how it threatens heroes (ranged or melee, physical or energy, etc.).
Optional: add one or two abilities.
Optional: note its usual tactics in a sentence or two.
minions.countNote: Published minions note how many appear, typically per hero (for example, "1 per hero").

dieSizes.advice: Large groups of high-die minions get dangerous quickly. To make minions more capable without that risk, give them situational bonuses through abilities instead of a bigger die.

abilityGuidelines.count: Usually none; one, or at most two, if they need to stand out.
suggestedEffects: A bonus to one basic action under specific conditions
A bonus to Boosts targeting an ally in the same location
A bonus to Hinders targeting an enemy
A bonus to Defends protecting one ally
A bonus to damage
A bonus to saves
Attack an extra target (usually with a penalty)
Move between locations without spending an action

Sacrifice itself to: shield a villain from one damage source; Attack all enemies in its location (with a penalty); give all allies in its location a bonus; give all enemies in its location a penalty; Recover a villain's Health by its roll; bring an environment threat or twist into play; or split into smaller-die minions

lieutenants.summary: Built like minions, but tougher (a successful save doesn't reduce their die) and with more and better abilities. They can be elite followers, superpowered underlings, monsters, or war machines.
lieutenants.naming: Usually unique or special; individuals often get a full name and a title.

dieSizes.note: A d6 lieutenant suits a threat that isn't very deadly but is hard to get rid of.

suggestedEffects: Any of the minion ability effects
A bonus to two or more basic actions under specific conditions
A bonus to Boosts
One Boost that affects several allies in the same location
A bonus to Hinders
One Hinder that affects several enemies in the same location
A bonus to Defends
One Defend that protects several allies in the same location
Attack or Defend plus Boost an ally from the same roll
Attack or Defend plus Hinder an enemy from the same roll
A special action: create standard minions based on its roll; Recover a villain's Health by its roll; bring an environment threat or twist into play; or move a hero to another location
Sacrifice itself to: let a villain escape; let a villain act during the lieutenant's turn; or advance the scene tracker one space

lieutenants.massiveFoes: For truly colossal threats, the book suggests combining an environment (for its actions), challenges (to defeat it), and threats (that protect it) rather than a single lieutenant.

sceneDifficulty.summary: H = number of heroes in the scene; ½H rounds up. In a group of minions, two minions can be traded for one lieutenant one die size larger.

tiers.challenges: 1–2 successes, or 1 success plus an added complication
3–4 successes, or 1–2 successes plus an added complication
5+ successes, or 3–4 successes plus an added complication
